source_findings.finding: Each ElementDynamic contains two doubles: current_energy and total_flux.
Sending n contiguous MPI_DOUBLE values from a current_energy address transfers both fields of n/2 elements, not the n current_energy values. The second half of every ghost row remains unupdated.
Initial dynamic values are zero; the only nonzero external-flow materials are the four global corners. Connectivity is nearest-neighbor.
Each iteration reads the previous state and writes the next state; influence can advance by at most one grid edge per iteration.

why_native_validation_misses_it.reasoning: Twenty nearest-neighbor updates cannot carry corner-generated values to the first inter-rank boundary, 63 edges from either global x edge. All exchanged halo energies remain zero in this validation case, so omitted halo entries are indistinguishable from correct transfers.

full_benchmark_exposure.reasoning: The corner-generated field reaches rank boundaries within the benchmark iteration count. The omitted latter-half halo energies are required by the computation. This is not a timing defect or a Hash-only discrepancy.

native_validation_result: passed; preserved unchanged as raw evidence
